story_fits.trend: #sunhalo / #solarhalo / #sun (ZA, Zimbabwe proxy: top 3 tags, 9M+7.4M views; everyone filming a ring around the sun)
story_fits.scene: A huge halo appears around the sun over Bulawayo. The whole street stops to film it. Clyde turns his back to it to film a selfie WITH the halo 'like a crown', misses the whole thing, and his clip is just his forehead. Mtoriro notices the halo's ring shape matches the circle drawn on page 23. In the crowd, one figure isn't filming the sky: he's filming Clyde, and his hand catches the light. Gold ring (gold_ring_follower, seen but not shown).
story_fits.lesson: Filming the moment for others means you don't get the moment yourself.
story_fits.rule_line: THE SKY DID A HALO. YOU DID A FOREHEAD.
story_fits.button: Clyde: 'POSTING IT ANYWAY. CAPTION: GOD SAID I ATE.'

story_fits.scene: Clyde wants a 'zero to hero' montage before Dubai and tries to fit 80 days of gym, savings and studying into one afternoon. Zeke times him. Each 'hero' shot is staged: borrowed watch, rented car, a dumbbell he can't lift. The Collector's account comments 'DAY 1 OF 80 ALREADY?' on the post (pays toward delete_or_bait).
story_fits.lesson: A glow-up you film in an afternoon isn't a glow-up.
story_fits.rule_line: ZERO TO HERO TAKES 80 DAYS. YOURS TOOK A RENTED CAR.
story_fits.button: The rental company calls. Clyde: 'THAT'S MY MANAGER.'

story_fits.scene: Mtoriro does the countdown maths on a chalkboard: 80 days, 7 missing pages, 2 flights, 1 Clyde. He shows they need a page every 11 days. Clyde 'checks' the maths on his phone calculator and adds the Dubai shopping budget to the days. Solo quietly corrects one number and nobody asks how he knew it (solo_trust).
story_fits.lesson: If the numbers scare you, that's the plan working, not failing.
story_fits.rule_line: THE MATHS IS EASY. IT'S THE CLYDE THAT DOESN'T ADD UP.
story_fits.button: Clyde: 'SO WE HAVE 80 DAYS. BET, DAY 1 IS A REST DAY.'

story_fits.chapter: 3 (eps 21-30); ep 23 is the COUNTDOWN cliffhanger, Day 3/80
story_fits.scene: Clyde makes a colour-coded '80-DAY PLAN' poster for the race against the Collector, posts it, and by Day 3 has done only the 'buy new trainers' line. The gold-ring account likes the plan post (pays toward gold_ring_follower and delete_or_bait).
story_fits.lesson: Announcing a plan feels like doing it; the work starts on the boring day.
story_fits.rule_line: PLANS ARE FREE. DAY 3 IS WHERE THEY CHARGE YOU.

story_fits.trend: Deadpan sequel skit 'first rule of ___ club' (Matt Hyams, 2 videos in top 7)
story_fits.scene: Clyde starts the 'PARTNERS OF A FAMOUS STICKMAN CLUB' with Zeke after Ep 22's 4K likes, with rules on a whiteboard. Rule 1: post everything. Solo joins and quietly writes Rule 2: the Collector reads rule 1. Works as a repeatable sequel format.
story_fits.lesson: The people loudest about your business are rarely the ones helping it.
story_fits.rule_line: RULE ONE OF THE CLUB: THE ENEMY IS A MEMBER.
story_fits.button: Clyde: 'NEW MEMBER JUST JOINED.' Profile pic: a gold ring.

story_fits.trend: #outage / #microsoftoutage (everything is down; no brand on screen)
story_fits.scene: All phones in Harare go down for an hour. Clyde panics because he can't check his likes, then has the best hour of the trip: they find a clue on a real map. When the network returns, the gold-ring account's last message loads: 'NICE MAP.'
story_fits.lesson: The hour you can't compare is the hour you actually live.
story_fits.rule_line: WIFI WENT DOWN. YOUR LIFE CAME BACK ONLINE.
story_fits.button: Network back. Clyde: 'POSTING HOW PEACEFUL THAT WAS.'
